{{Top|leg}}
A '''conditioning procedure''' was a type of surgical operation that would have effects similar to brainwashing. The only known practitioner of this operation was the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who attempted to perform it on [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]] and [[Zinn Toa/Legends|Zinn Toa]], [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|infants]] to build an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] adepts, but he did not have enough [[Time/Legends|time]] to do this, because of the [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|intervention]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="COTF">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref>
